feature.name: Cross-Repo Version Gating
feature.description: Activated the requiredAnalyticsVersion field in CMD's package.json, enabling the deploy script to block deployment if the server's CMUA version is below the required minimum (v1.01).

commits: feat: activate requiredAnalyticsVersion gating for CMUA dependency
framing: This activates a safety net in the deployment pipeline — CMD can now declare a minimum CMUA version, preventing broken deploys when CMD relies on newer CMUA features. It's the first cross-repo dependency gate in the dashboard ecosystem.
